after.a passer validated on the holdout: proposed to the owner as a paper strategy of its own (rule 14), sized by the risk engine; never real money
after.otherwise: reported as it is; nothing changes

gates.costs_x2: mean net > 0 with spread, slippage and commission all doubled
gates.leave_one_pair_out: mean net > 0 leaving out any one pair
gates.specificity: the month-end mean exceeds the same rule on every other weekday of the month (Welch t >= 2)
gates.t: t of the mean net bps over 2009-2016 >= the registry's Bonferroni threshold
gates.top_year: no single year supplies more than 50% of the total net
gates.years: >= 60% of the years have positive net

spec.holdout_rule: only for a passer, through the registry's final-test procedure on 2017-01..2018-05 (the sealed fx-majors holdout): mean net > 0 and mean net > 0 with costs x2

hypotheses.MEH1-H1-13-16: On the last weekday of the month each USD major moves from 13:00 to 16:00 London in the direction month-end equity-hedge rebalancing implies: the dollar weakens when the S&P 500 beat the pair's home index month to date through the day before, and strengthens when it trailed

spec.question: does month-end equity-hedge rebalancing move the USD majors into the London 4 pm fix, in the direction the month's US-versus-home equity returns imply?
